method_note: Overall performance is a transparent doctrine-alignment score. Evidence marking uses category-balanced, chance-corrected skill. Credible and Excellent labels require evidence-analysis floors. Action plans must remain within explicit time and authority budgets. Diagnostic meters do not override the score headline. Public interfaces use five positively directed indicators; public pressure is displayed separately as scenario state.

civilian_protection.description: How well vulnerable people and identities are protected.
civilian_protection.label: Civilian Protection

decision_timeliness.description: How promptly the player acts without outrunning evidence.
decision_timeliness.label: Decision Timeliness

escalation_control.description: How effectively the decision reduces avoidable escalation.
escalation_control.label: Escalation Control

evidence_integrity.description: How closely claims and evidence remain aligned.
evidence_integrity.label: Evidence Integrity

institutional_credibility.description: How well the process could withstand later scrutiny.
institutional_credibility.label: Institutional Credibility

public_pressure.description: Scenario pressure is context, not a performance score.
public_pressure.label: Public Pressure
